verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a self-hosted Git service with an API, but the pack never documents scoped or least-privilege API tokens. The API usage guide mentions only "authentication" in general, and the generic "user permission management, access control lists" claims are adjacent controls, not scoped credential issuance for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
